component: IMAP offline playback state and folder flags

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The cleanup replaces CreatedOffline with Unused1 at the same 0x02000000 value and removes the associated folder-creation prepass. Ordinary OfflineEvents playback and its asynchronous callbacks remain. The start flag is now m_started and still initializes false before its mode-specific traversal. This source change does not clear old stored bits or prove every profile and external interface consumer is compatible; no profile migration or offline replay ran.
title: Removing offline-folder creation playback preserves the old numeric flag slot
